title: Ledger checks each task's size (200-line rule)
acceptance: A task's size is the lines added plus lines deleted between its recorded base commit and an end commit, counting text files only, and leaving out goals/*.json and lockfiles (bun.lock, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, Cargo.lock, go.sum)
When `hq merge` merges a goal, it records a `task.lines` event (added, deleted, end commit) for every task started on that goal that is not shelved, with the approved goal commit as the end commit
`hq task lines <task> [--rev <rev>]` records the same event by hand; the end commit defaults to the head of the task's goal branch, and it refuses a rev that is not a commit

`hq stats` shows how many tasks have a size, and lists the tasks under 200 lines with their size; tasks with no size are counted as not checked, never as passing. `hq stats --tasks` rows include the size

End-to-end tests in hq/test with a real git repository and a temporary HQ_HOME cover: the size rule and its exclusions, the event written by a real merge, the manual command and its refusals, and the stats output
known_issues: hq merge appends the `merge` ledger event after main has moved, unguarded: a failed write (full disk) still makes hq merge throw after merging. Pre-existing since M0.3, not this goal's; found by the answerer in rework 1.
